q: How many customers are in each country?
gold: SELECT country, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

q: List the products in the kitchen category.
gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'kitchen'

q: What is the most expensive product?
gold: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price_cents DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE placed_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

q: What is the total number of units sold per product category, counting only delivered orders?
gold: SELECT p.category, sum(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category

q: What was the total revenue in dollars from delivered orders?
gold: SELECT round(sum(oi.quantity * p.price_cents) / 100.0, 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

q: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

q: Which month in 2025 had the most orders? Give the month as YYYY-MM.
gold: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', placed_on) AS m FROM orders WHERE placed_on LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY m ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average number of items (sum of quantities) per order?
gold: SELECT round(avg(t), 2) FROM (SELECT sum(quantity) AS t FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

q: Which customer id spent the most on delivered orders?
gold: SELECT o.customer_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY sum(oi.quantity * p.price_cents) DESC LIMIT 1
